name: What damages can I recover after a personal injury accident?

mainEntity.name: What damages can I recover after a personal injury accident?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can recover economic damages (medical bills, lost wages, property loss) and non-economic damages (pain and suffering, emotional distress, loss of enjoyment). In serious or egregious cases, punitive damages may also be available to punish wrongdoers.hasselllawgroup+2​
